claim_boundary.supported: The public clustered powered V2 contract is internally consistent, action-free, independently reviewed, and ready for exact-main CI followed by one finite private capacity census against the bound digest.

external_reviews.adjudication: Accepted all three refinements: derive rather than copy the intracluster-correlation table, close without promotion above three incomplete development endpoints, and require a separately sized Crystal transfer plan.

Accepted the substance and strengthened it: per-title declared target totals replace a Red-only cap; friendship evolution and roaming legendaries are explicit; boundary assertions and alpha, power, contingency, and schedule mutation tests are binding.

next_gate.failure_rule: If a disjoint outcome-blind allocation cannot supply 36 train, 100 development, and 3 contingency lineages with every support floor, close the lane before gameplay.
next_gate.pass_rule: Freeze the qualifying allocation and begin the first bounded train collection batch in the same work session so the one-session no-learning-output alarm is not reset by another process-only gate.
